corrected_content.problem:
Find the fundamental vector product of the surface defined by the equations

$$
\displaystyle x = u + v, y = v^{2} + \sin u, z = uv.
$$
corrected_content.worked_solution: The fundamental vector product is $r_u\times r_v$, in that order. We have $r_u=\langle1,\cos u,v\rangle$ and $r_v=\langle1,2v,u\rangle$. Expanding the cross product gives $$r_u\times r_v=\langle u\cos u-2v^2,v-u,2v-\cos u\rangle.$$
